*   "आवाज नहीं आ रही आपको" (You are not getting voice) - Technical issue.

*   "कैसे हो?" (How are you?) - Small talk/Greeting (Never a violation).

**Review against Categories:**

The provided audio snippet contains only greetings, small talk, and technical issues. There are no violations according to the defined policy.
